title: Nem Nuong with Caramelized Apples
description: A twist on traditional Nem Nuong, this Vietnamese dish adds a sweet and energizing touch with caramelized apples and crispy glassy-jelly texture.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, salt, black pepper, fish sauce, and grated ginger. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Add the egg and mix until the egg is fully incorporated.
Add the all-purpose flour and mix until just combined.
Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Using a small ice cream scoop or your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Place the patties on the preheated skillet or griddle and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
While the patties are cooking, prepare the caramelized apples by heating a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced apples and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until caramelized.
To make the glassy-jelly texture, mix the honey and water in a small bowl until well combined.
Add the glassy-jelly mixture to the cooked patties and serve immediately on a Talavera plate with the caramelized apples.
